negative_findings.description: Several licensed or newly licensed MK e-money/payment institutions (Flex Pay, MINT Fintech Group, and, in this pass, Paysera's MK arm) could not be tied to a confirmed corporate press-room URL. Their announcements surfaced only through mk media reproductions.
negative_findings.result_summary: Actor confirmed to exist; owned publishing channel not located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for these actors must be media-mediated, which adds latency and paraphrase risk; the source list will look thinner than the market actually is.

negative_findings.description: mk queries combining remittance vocabulary ('дознаки', 'брз трансфер на пари') with 'соопштение'/'нова услуга' returned only static bank product pages for Western Union — no dated press releases from remittance operators or their MK agents.
negative_findings.result_summary: Remittance-corridor news appears not to be published as PR in MK; only tariff/product pages exist.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Remittances are economically large for MK, so the absence of a PR channel means corridor change must be inferred from tariff-page diffs and NBRM statistics instead.

negative_findings.description: No established Macedonian-language term was found in use for SoftPOS or BNPL; searches had to fall back to the English-in-local forms ('SoftPOS', 'BNPL', 'одложено плаќање' untested).
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language glossary gap for two of the cell's named product themes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without correct mk terms these product launches will be missed by mk-language monitoring; needs a glossary-building pass with native phrasing variants.

negative_findings.description: The NBRM registers of payment institutions and e-money institutions are described in regulation and referenced on nbrm.mk, but the exact register listing URL was not isolated in this pass — only the governing decision page was.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register exists and is public; direct URL unresolved, not dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This register is the backbone of the actor map for the whole cell; leaving it unresolved caps the completeness of any downstream actor list.

brief: North Macedonia's non-bank payments actors publish almost nothing in IR form, so the usable source landscape for this cell is: (1) a small set of company-owned channels — CaSys, Halkbank/HalkPay, Nayax and, uniquely, the bond-listed Iute Group whose IutePay Skopje EMI licence generates wire-grade releases; (2) mk-language trade and business media (bankarstvo.mk, pari.com.mk, faktor.mk, mkd.mk, it.mk) which in practice reproduce company PR that has no other home; and (3) pointer registries — the NBRM PI/EMI registers, ecommerce.mk and AFD member directories, and Startup Macedonia — which are the only reliable way to enumerate new actors such as Flex Pay, MKPEJ/mkPay and MINT Fintech Group. App-store release notes are a strong under-used substitute for press releases among MK wallet issuers. Main weaknesses are an unresolved NBRM register deep link, missing mk vocabulary for SoftPOS/BNPL, and the total absence of remittance-operator PR in mk.
